mainEntity.name: How do I find a reputable stucco contractor in the Mission Viejo area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When seeking a reputable stucco contractor in the Mission Viejo area, start by looking for companies with extensive experience specifically in stucco application and repair. Check for proper licensing, insurance, and worker's compensation coverage to protect yourself. Request references from previous clients and review their portfolios. Look for contractors who provide detailed, written estimates outlining all costs, materials, and timelines. Also, consider their communication style and willingness to answer all your questions. A trustworthy contractor will prioritize quality workmanship and clear communication.
